newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia names first new-generation Chief of Staff.
newsitem.headline: Croatia names first new-generation Chief of Staff.

text.p: General Pavao Miljavac, who rose to prominence in the 1991 war for independence from Yugoslavia, on Monday became Croatia's first chief of staff not to have had a previous career in the former Yugoslav army.

Croatian radio said Miljavac, 43, would replace the retiring General Zvonimir Cervenko on November 16. Miljavac was a brigade and sector commander in Karlovac, south of Zagreb, before becoming deputy chief of staff.
He was also part of a team in operational command of battles the Croatian army fought against Serbs in Croatia and western Bosnia last year.
